name: loginpageqatesting
description: A high-performance, strictly monochrome (Black & White) web application designed specifically for **Quality Assurance (QA)** and **Quality Control (QC)** testing of authentication flows, internationalization, fault injection, accessibility, and UI states.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
